title: दिवाली का खौफनाक रिजल्ट 💀 | Diwali Result Day Twist #shorts
description: दिवाली के दिन रोहन का रिजल्ट आया, लेकिन ये खुशी की बात नहीं थी। क्या आंटी ने कोई काला जादू किया है? देखिए इस दिवाली का सबसे बड़ा ट्विस्ट। #horror #diwali #suspense #hindi #ai

characters.name: Rohan
characters.look: 18-year-old boy, wearing a bright yellow festive kurta, messy black hair, scared expression.

characters.name: Mrs. Sharma
characters.look: 50-year-old woman, wearing a dark red silk saree, heavy gold necklace, grey hair tied in a tight bun, creepy smile.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: दिवाली की रात रोहन का रिजल्ट आने वाला था।
scenes.image_prompt: Cinematic horror style, Rohan an 18-year-old boy in a yellow kurta looking nervously at his smartphone screen, room lit by flickering oil lamps (diyas), dark shadows on the walls, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: उसे पता था वो फेल होगा, पर फोन पर सब बदल गया।
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of Rohan's face, the blue light of the phone reflecting in his wide eyes, a mix of shock and disbelief, background blurred with festive lights, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: हर विषय में पूरे सौ नंबर, ये नामुमकिन था।
scenes.image_prompt: Extreme close up of a smartphone screen showing a school report card with '100/100' in every subject, the edges of the screen look like they are decaying or covered in black soot, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: तभी खिड़की के बाहर पड़ोसी शर्मा आंटी रहस्यमयी ढंग से मुस्कुराईं।
scenes.image_prompt: Looking through a window, Mrs. Sharma a 50-year-old woman in a red silk saree standing in the dark balcony across, her face half-lit by a single lamp, a chilling and wide smile, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: वो रंगों की जगह काली राख से डरावनी रंगोली बना रही थीं।
scenes.image_prompt: High angle shot of Mrs. Sharma kneeling on the floor, using grey volcanic-like ash to draw a complex occult symbol instead of a traditional floral rangoli, smoke rising from the ash, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: उन्होंने रोहन को देख कर अपनी उंगली होंठों पर रख ली।
scenes.image_prompt: Medium shot of Mrs. Sharma looking directly into the camera, placing a pale finger over her lips in a 'shh' gesture, her eyes glowing faintly red, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: फोन पर मैसेज चमका— 'तुम्हारी उम्र अब मेरी हुई।'
scenes.image_prompt: Close up of the phone screen with a new message notification in Hindi text 'तुम्हारी उम्र अब मेरी हुई', the text seems to be written in blood, the phone screen is cracking, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: रोहन के जवान हाथ अचानक बूढ़े और कमजोर होने लगे।
scenes.image_prompt: Rohan's hands holding the phone, the skin rapidly wrinkling, age spots appearing, veins popping out as if aging 50 years in seconds, yellow kurta sleeve visible, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: बाहर पटाखों का शोर अब डरावनी चीखों में बदल गया।
scenes.image_prompt: Wide shot of the night sky, fireworks exploding into shapes of screaming ghostly faces, the neighborhood houses looking dark and abandoned, eerie atmosphere, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: क्या आप भी ऐसी कामयाबी चाहेंगे?
scenes.image_prompt: Rohan's face now half-aged with grey hair on one side, staring at the camera with a hollow look, clutching a burning diya that is emitting black smoke, 9:16 vertical.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.narration: क्योंकि दिवाली की रात, रिजल्ट ने सबकी जान ले ली!
scenes.image_prompt: Low angle shot of the occult rangoli on the floor now glowing with a dark purple fire, the reflection of the fail-to-pass marksheet visible in a pool of black liquid, 9:16 vertical.
